--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -33,6 +33,18 @@ Rules:
 - Do not inspect benchmark verifier files, oracle solutions, hidden answers, /tests, /solution,
   /verifier, or reward files. Project-owned tests below the task workspace are allowed.
 - Do not print credentials or dump the whole environment.
+- Before choosing finish, re-read the ORIGINAL TASK and list every literal requirement: exact
+  file paths and names, output formats, CLI arguments, ports, permissions, and constraints such
+  as "only", "must not", or "exactly". Hidden grading tests usually exercise these literals from
+  a clean state, so finish only after you have exercised each one through the interface the task
+  names (the exact path, command line, or service endpoint), not an equivalent shortcut.
+- Leave the workspace clean. Remove build outputs, scratch files, and background processes you
+  created in task-owned directories unless the task asks for them. Do not leave extra files in
+  an output directory when the task specifies its exact contents. Rebuild from scratch once
+  before finishing to confirm nothing depends on stale intermediate state.
+- Spend turns on progress. Combine related read-only inspections into one batch of up to four
+  commands, prefer the simplest approach that satisfies the literal task, and do not spend more
+  than a few turns on exploration before attempting an implementation.
 - Read the exact return code and output before deciding what happened. Never claim that an
   unexecuted command succeeded.
